report:
Right kidney, radical nephrectomy

Received in formalin is a right radical nephrectomy specimen weighing 485 g and measuring 14.0 x 9.5 x 7.0 cm. Sectioning reveals a 84 mm (84 x 68 x 55 mm) tumour in the middle and hilum / renal sinus, circumscribed golden-yellow cortical mass with focal haemorrhage. Adrenal gland: unremarkable and uninvolved by tumour. Sections are submitted in 12 blocks.

(A1) ureteral and renal vascular margins.
(A2-A7) tumour with renal sinus interface and capsule.
(A8-A9) non-neoplastic kidney.
(A10) adrenal gland.
(A11-A12) renal hilar lymph nodes.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Radical nephrectomy
- Specimen laterality: Right
- Tumour focality: Unifocal
- Tumour site: Middle and hilum / renal sinus
- Tumour size (greatest dimension): 84 mm (84 x 68 x 55 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
- Histologic grade (WHO/ISUP): G4: Extreme nuclear pleomorphism, multinucleated
  giant cells, and/or rhabdoid and/or sarcomatoid differentiation
- Sarcomatoid features: Present (25%)
- Rhabdoid features: Not identified
- Tumour necrosis: Present (30%)
- Lymphovascular invasion (excluding renal vein / IVC): Present
- Tumour extension: Renal sinus fat; Renal vein or its segmental branches
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the kidney show clear cell renal cell carcinoma, G4: Extreme nuclear pleomorphism, multinucleated giant cells, and/or rhabdoid and/or sarcomatoid differentiation. Nests and acini of polygonal tumour cells with optically clear cytoplasm are separated by a delicate branching sinusoidal capillary network.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Involved by invasive carcinoma
- Involved margin(s): Renal vein margin

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 2 of 7 involved (renal hilar and paracaval)
- Extranodal extension (ENE): Present
- Size of largest metastatic deposit: 12 mm

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT3a pN1

Additional findings
- Non-neoplastic kidney: Arterionephrosclerosis / vascular disease

RIGHT KIDNEY, radical nephrectomy:
- CLEAR CELL RENAL CELL CARCINOMA, G4: Extreme nuclear pleomorphism,
  multinucleated giant cells, and/or rhabdoid and/or sarcomatoid
  differentiation, 84 mm
- Sarcomatoid features (25%) present
- Tumour extends into renal sinus fat and renal vein or its segmental branches
- Surgical margin involved by carcinoma (renal vein margin)
- 2 of 7 regional lymph nodes involved; extranodal extension present
- pT3a pN1 (AJCC 8th edition).
